def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    p={v:(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v in (1,2)}
    r,c=p[1]; R,C=p[2]
    dr=1 if R>r else -1; dc=1 if C>c else -1
    # Follow the diagonal until one step before the nearer coordinate alignment,
    # then continue on the other axis, stopping diagonally adjacent to 2.
    n=min(abs(R-r),abs(C-c))-1
    for i in range(1,n+1): g[r+dr*i][c+dc*i]=3
    rr=r+dr*n; cc=c+dc*n
    if abs(R-rr)>abs(C-cc):
        while rr != R-dr:
            rr+=dr; g[rr][cc]=3
    else:
        while cc != C-dc:
            cc+=dc; g[rr][cc]=3
    return g
PY

    if abs(R-rr)>abs(C-cc):
        while rr != R-dr:

    else:

            cc+=dc
            g[rr][cc]=3
